name: Hearthglen
shortDescription: Classic Hearthglen is a fortified human settlement: pale stone and timber, practical defenses and red-white Scarlet Crusade banners against damaged fields. Do not confuse it with Stormwind Keep.
body: Classic Hearthglen is a fortified human settlement: pale stone and timber, practical defenses and red-white Scarlet Crusade banners against damaged fields.
